_instructions: Copy this file to appsettings.json (which is git-ignored) and replace every <placeholder> with your own local values. Never commit real credentials. Alternatively override with environment variables using __ separators, e.g. ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection and SeedAccounts__AdminPassword.

SeedAccounts._instructions: Development-only account passwords, read by Program.cs when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development. Prefer: dotnet user-secrets set "SeedAccounts:AdminPassword" <value>

AttendanceTime._instructions: IANA time zone id used for every attendance window decision, date, and time-zone label. Optional: when omitted the app falls back to Asia/Manila. Use e.g. Pacific/Auckland or UTC for other deployments.
